page.layout: One printed page, a two-column table of Scripture references with a centre rule dividing the left and right blocks. Head line "Locorum Scripturæ." at top centre. Left block: columns Cap. | Verf. | Pag. (Matthew and Mark entries). Right block: columns Cap. | Verf. | Pag. (Luke entries). Subheads MARCUS. and LUCAS. inside the table. No running head, no page number, no catchword.

page.notes: The table is set in two blocks with a centre rule; the left block is headed Cap./Verf./Pag. and the right block likewise. Lines are shown joined with " || " at the rule. Subheads MARCUS. and LUCAS. stand in the table at mid-height and are placed in their printed positions in the left and right blocks respectively; the transcription places them after the rows they follow, so their position is approximate. Last line "Cap.V." appears at the foot of the right block. Some numerals (e.g. "1o71", "I9") are ambiguous; read as printed where clear. Several entries marked "[?]" were not assessed as doubtful.
